# Test dependencies for openframe-protocol local development
#
# CI does NOT use this file — each package's own app-test.yml matrix row
# installs that package's dev extras directly (pip install -e ".[dev]"),
# isolated per package (see .github/workflows/app-test.yml). This file
# exists purely as a local-dev convenience shortcut for running every
# package's tests in one shared environment from the repo root, without
# entering each package directory one at a time:
#   pip install -r .github/requirements/test.txt
#   pytest packages/
#
# Keep in sync with every package's pyproject.toml when adding a package or
# bumping a dependency floor — nothing enforces this automatically.

# ── Test runner ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
pytest>=8.0
pytest-asyncio>=0.23
pytest-mock>=3.14

# ── Transport runtime deps ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# Pinned at minimum supported floors — mirrors each package's pyproject.toml.

# openframe-protocol-http [server]
fastapi>=0.110

# openframe-protocol-http [client]
httpx>=0.27

# openframe-protocol-grpc [server]/[client] (both pull the same dependency —
# see that package's own pyproject.toml docstring for why) + [dev]'s own
# grpcio-tools (.proto compilation, build-time only) and pydantic (the
# conformance driver's INVALID-category test scenario, see
# tests/test_conformance.py's own docstring)
grpcio>=1.60
grpcio-tools>=1.60
pydantic>=2.0

# ── Shared transitive dep ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Every package in this repo depends on openframe-core directly. Pinned
# here at the floor every package's own pyproject.toml already declares —
# develop and test against the latest 3.x release (3.7.0 as of this file).
openframe-core>=3.2.1,<4
